title: Winkelmann Group Overview, Address & Contact - Prospeo
content: Fabricated Metal Products• Flag of DEAhlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany • 201-500 Employees. | Websites | winkelmann-group.comwinkelmann-group.de |. The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. Winkelmann Group is located in Ahlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, DE.
